# rnoh-on-harmony-pc

在一台 HarmonyOS PC 上，用 RNOH（React Native for OpenHarmony）从零跑通一个 React Native 应用的完整工程。

本仓库是以下这篇实战文章的配套代码，文章记录了整个环境搭建过程的每一步排查：

> 《鸿蒙 PC 上用 RNOH 开发开源鸿蒙应用》

应用在 HUAWEI MateBook Pro（HAD-W32，HarmonyOS 7.0）上的实际运行效果：

Image: 运行效果

## 版本配套

组件  | 版本
--- | ---
React Native  | 0.84.1
@react-native-oh/react-native-harmony  | 0.84.4
@react-native-oh/react-native-harmony-cli  | 0.84.4
OpenHarmony SDK  | API 26（26.0.0.105）
ohpm  | 6.0.1
hvigorw  | 7.26.8
hdc  | 3.2.0f
Node.js  | v26.12.0（要求 ≥ 22.11.0）

> RNOH 是多版本线并行的项目。本仓库对应官方 `0.84-stable` 分支，不要混用其他版本线的文档与包。

## 环境要求

  * Node.js ≥ 22.11.0
  * OpenHarmony SDK（命令行工具链由 HNP 包 `hmos-clt` 提供，含 `ohpm` / `hvigorw` / `hdc` / SDK；装 DevEco Studio 亦可）
  * git
  * 构建 HAP 不需要 JDK（SDK 的 `hap-sign-tool` 与 `ohos_packing_tool` 均为原生可执行文件）

需要配置的环境变量：
    
    `export DEVECO_SDK_HOME="<工具链根目录>/sdk"
    export RNOH_C_API_ARCH=1        # RNOH 走 CAPI 架构，必须为 1
    export HDC_SERVER_PORT=7035     # hdc 服务端口
    `

## 目录结构
    
    `rnoh-on-harmony-pc/
    ├── App.tsx                     # RN 入口页面（已移除 safe-area 依赖）
    ├── metro.config.js             # 已接入 createHarmonyMetroConfig
    ├── package.json                # 含 "dev": "react-native bundle-harmony --dev"
    ├── index.js
    ├── android/  ios/              # RN 模板自带，本仓库未使用
    ├── docs/
    │   ├── 鸿蒙PC上用RNOH开发开源鸿蒙应用.md    # 配套实战文章
    │   ├── RNOH-环境说明.md                    # 环境信息与踩坑速查
    │   └── images/
    └── harmony/                    # 鸿蒙工程
        ├── build-profile.template.json5        # 配置模板（需派生为 build-profile.json5）
        ├── hvigor/hvigor-config.json5          # 引入 @rnoh/hvigor-plugin
        ├── AppScope/app.json5                  # bundleName: com.nutpi.myapplication
        └── entry/
            └── src/main/
                ├── cpp/                        # CMakeLists.txt + PackageProvider.cpp
                ├── ets/pages/Index.ets         # 含 bundle.harmony.js 回落加载
                └── resources/rawfile/          # bundle 产物落在这里（不入库）
    `

## 几个容易踩的点

现象  | 原因  | 处理
--- | --- | ---
`init-harmony` 崩：`paths[0] must be of type string`  | CLI 用了 Node 22+ 已移除的 `fs.Dirent.path`  | 打上面的 RealFS.js 补丁
报 `00303027 Configuration Error: modelVersion`  | `hvigor-config.json5` 与 `oh-package.json5` 的 `modelVersion` 不一致  | 两处保持一致
编译报 `cannot open file ...: Interrupted system call`  | 高并发编译下文件系统偶发 EINTR，非代码问题  | 直接重跑 `hvigorw assembleHap`，ninja 会增量推进
链接时报找不到 `.o` / `libfolly.a`  | 构建期间改动了源码，ninja 日志与实际文件脱节  | 构建期间别改代码；必要时 `rm -rf entry/.cxx entry/build` 重建
装上了、启动了、但白屏  | `Index.ets` 只找 `hermes_bundle.hbc`，而 `npm run dev` 产出的是 `bundle.harmony.js`  | 本仓库已修复（加了回落加载）
鸿蒙上白屏  | RN 0.84 模板的 `App.tsx` 依赖 `react-native-safe-area-context`  | 本仓库已改为显式传 `safeAreaInsets`

完整排查过程见 docs/ 下的两篇文档。

## 相关链接

  * RNOH 官方仓库：CPF-RN/ohos_react_native
  * 官方《环境搭建》：0.84-stable 分支
  * 官方《版本说明》：dist-tag 规则与安装方式
  * React Native：reactnative.dev
  * OpenHarmony：openharmony.cn

citeturn7search1 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2 months ago; Crawled: 2 days ago; ` macros in `tauri-runtime-wry`, which have no `cfg(target_env = "ohos")` branch — they expand to the same path on every platform:
### 2. Window getters, when called off the main thread, block-wait for the main thread (and this is not OHOS-specific)

The window getters (`is_maximized`, `inner_size`, ...) go through the `window_getter!` / `getter!` macros in `tauri-runtime-wry`, which have no `cfg(target_env = "ohos")` branch — they expand to the same path on every platform:

`crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs`
    
    macro_rules! getter {
      ($self: ident, $rx: expr, $message: expr) => {{
        $crate::send_user_message(&$self.context, $message)?;   // route to event loop
        $rx.recv()                                                // block until the main thread answers
          .map_err(|_| $crate::Error::FailedToReceiveMessage)
      }};
    }
    macro_rules! window_getter {
      ($self: ident, $message: expr) => {{
        let (tx, rx) = channel();
        getter!($self, rx, Message::Window($self.window_id, $message(tx)))
      }};
    }

`send_user_message` short-circuits only when the caller is the main thread; otherwise it enqueues via `proxy.send_event` (non-blocking) and the caller then blocks on `rx.recv()` until the main thread services the message from its event loop:
    
    pub(crate) fn send_user_message<T: UserEvent>(context: &Context<T>, message: Message<T>) -> Result<()> {
      if current_thread().id() == context.main_thread_id {
        handle_user_message(...);   // same-thread fast path
        Ok(())
      } else {
        context.proxy.send_event(message).map_err(...)   // enqueue + wake main thread
      }
    }

`grep -n "ohos" crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs` returns zero hits — the getter path is identical on PC (Windows/Linux/macOS) and OHOS. So this is not an OHOS-specific quirk; on any platform, an off-main-thread getter call blocks the caller on `recv()` waiting for the main thread's event loop.

### How this seems to form a circular wait

If a plugin holds an internally-shared `Mutex` across such a getter, then while the getter is parked on `recv` waiting for the main thread, the worker still holds that `Mutex`. If, during that window, the main thread fires a window event whose handler takes the same `Mutex`, the main thread blocks on the lock — and so it never returns to its event loop to service the `WindowMessage` the worker is `recv`-ing on. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Tauri prototype for OpenHarmony/HarmonyNext

## Setup

  1. Install tauri-cli and ohrs from git.
    
    cargo install tauri-cli --git https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri --branch feat/open-harmony
    
    cargo install ohrs

  2. Clone the repo
    
    git clone https://github.com/islatri/tauri-ohos-test.git

  3. Install the dependencies.
    
    npm i
    
    cd src-tauri && cargo fetch

## Build and run

Build with tauri-cli.
    
    cd src-tauri && cargo tauri ohos build

## Note

  1. `libentry.so` is a template library and you can ignore it.
  2. `RustAbility` will forward lifecycle automatically.
  3. The frontend API test board currently covers runtime(core), app, path, filesystem, event, webview, and window/monitor APIs.

## 鸿蒙 PC 端

### 说明
1. 这个项目本质是适配了`ohos`的 Electron 本身
2. 本项目启动后，Electron 会加载运行`web_engine/src/main/resources/resfile/resources/app`
3. `web_engine/src/main/resources/resfile/resources/app` 是通过 [vue-pc-chat](https://github.com/wildfirechat/vue-pc-chat) 打包生成的

### 更新野火IM PC端功能
请参考[README_ohos.md](https://github.com/wildfirechat/vue-pc-chat/blob/master/README_ohos.md)

### 运行
1. 解压`libelectron.so.zip`，将解压出来的`libelectron.so`放到`electron/libs/arm64-v8a/`目录下
2. 鸿蒙 PC SDK，也就是`electron/libs/marswrapper.node`文件，是需要付费的，默认只能连到官方服务。请联系官方申请试用，申请后，请替换该文件
3. 使用`DevEco Studio`即可运行、打包、发布

### 模拟器调试特别说明
由于模拟器不支持硬件加速，打包`vue-pc-chat`时，需要禁用硬件加速；
```c
//background.js 文件搜索下面这行，并取消注释
//app.disableHardwareAcceleration();
```
但正式发布时，不能禁用硬件加速，以便获得更好的体验

### 上架前，特殊权限申请
```
ohos.permission.READ_WRITE_DESKTOP_DIRECTORY
ohos.permission.SYSTEM_FLOAT_WINDOW
ohos.permission.READ_WRITE_DOCUMENTS_DIRECTORY
ohos.permission.READ_WRITE_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY
ohos.permission.READ_PASTEBOARD
ohos.permission.FILE_ACCESS_PERSIST

```

### electron 版本
项目当前使用的版本是`v34.8.5`，[下载地址](https://devcloud.cn-north-4.huaweicloud.com/codehub/project/b19f5ea8ffd4492ea8c06ca2ebf3f858/codehub/2821214/home?ref=electron34-release&filePath=v34.8.5-20260729.1-release.zip&isFile=true)

### 参考
[ohos electron](https://gitcode.com/openharmony-sig/electron)

### 联系我们
微信：wfchat 或 wildfirechat
